name: ro-array-core-power-extracted-routed
description: Issue #217's routing-level post-layout re-run of sim/tb/ro-array-core-power-extracted/ against layout/pex/ro_array_core.routed.extracted.spice (klt extract --parasitics over the assembled ro_ring11/ro_ring11_ring2 GDS -- see layout/pex/build.py). Same DUT topology/rails/measurement expressions as the leaf-level (#17) testbench; both rings now carry their own real hand-routed inter-stage wiring instead of an idealised leaf-cell chain. The buffer/XOR stage stays leaf-level (layout/pex/build.py's own docstring, 'Two composed drop-ins, different scope'). Active-power claim of issue #14, re-derived at the binding worst corner with ring routing parasitics included.
